meta.source: Mixed dataset: 55 manually captured Google Play screenshots (1-star filter) plus additional public review excerpts from a GitHub mirror of Google Play reviews
meta.playStoreRatingNote: The original manually captured screenshots showed 4.6. The currently accessible Google Play listing showed 4.3 when checked on 2026-10-11. Ratings can vary by locale and change over time; neither value is the average of this review sample.
meta.notes: Reviewer names omitted. 'verified' is false until a human confirms the category. 'complete' is false when the screenshot cut the review off.
meta.additionalSource: https://github.com/Drishtita/MoveinsyncRatings (data/reviews.csv; described by repository as collected using google-play-scraper, India store)
meta.additionalSourceNote: Added records are a small, curated subset of publicly available review records. Categories and severity are provisional and have not been independently verified. This is not a random or representative sample of all users; do not infer overall sentiment from it.

categories.name: Authentication & Session Management
categories.action: Investigate session expiry, token refresh and OTP delivery; improve error messages and recovery.

categories.name: Booking & No-Show Errors
categories.action: Audit booking vs assignment vs no-show records; make date, shift and status unmistakable.

categories.name: GPS, Tracking & ETA
categories.action: Flag stale location updates, show last-refreshed time, improve ETA accuracy.

categories.name: Cab Allocation & Pickup
categories.action: Review allocation latency and driver-call workflow; clarify pickup instructions.

categories.name: App Performance & Usability
categories.action: Measure startup time, API latency and crash rate; simplify repeated prompts and flows.

categories.name: Notifications & Check-In
categories.action: Add pickup-point and check-in reminders; monitor notification delivery.

categories.name: Customer Support
categories.action: Provide ticket reference, status and escalation path; improve helpdesk reachability.

categories.name: Other / General Service
categories.action: Manually review; likely transport-operations or vendor management, not an app defect.

reviews.text: I had a suggestion to add a smart notification feature to remind the user for check-in after the vehicle crosses their pickup point. Sometimes, the vehicle arrives late or we miss by mistake to check-in, then we are marked as "No show" and it comes as a surprise. Introducing this one feature will help a lot for both transportation and end users. This may sound silly but even a small thing matters a lot.

The recent updates in the UI have made the app very difficult to use. Booking a shuttle is now a 2 step process previously it used to be 1. I got confused and thought I had booked a cab while I hadn't. Was too late in realising that. Such major changes need to be released in a better way rather than just throwing them in the user's face. Another bad thing is even though I am in 1 cab but I can see all the ones available for that time. I don't need to see others, just show me mine.

The GPS tracking system is very slow, and the pickup and drop timings are frequently incorrect. Additionally, the live location of other users is often not visible. Due to these issues, we are unable to determine the correct vehicle location, which is causing inconvenience. Kindly investigate and resolve

The app frequently crashes or hangs while booking cabs, which makes it really frustrating, especially when I'm in a hurry. The GPS tracking is unreliable—it often shows the driver in the wrong location, causing unnecessary delays. Notifications are delayed or sometimes don't come at all, so I end up missing important updates about my ride.

Every now and then i receive notifications saying that I have an older version in my mobile and reminds me to update it to the latest version. When I open playstore to upgrade the same, i would already been using the latest one. Further, when i try to track the vehicle, app doesn't work 100% as it seldom updates the location and all of a sudden the cab location changes by miles. Also, 9 out of 10 times it wouldn't connect to the driver and always has issues reaching them through app dialing.

I am extremely frustrated with this app. Booking transport has become unnecessarily difficult because even when I carefully select specific dates, the system ends up creating bookings for completely different dates.To make matters worse, I was reported as a "No Show" despite having made a booking. What is even more confusing is that I then received a notification asking me to rate the trip, yet the system claims I never showed up. How does that make any sense? Fees will be deducted from my salary

Keeps logging out after every 5 to 10 mins of inactivity on the app. Logging in again requires authentication via company's app which is time consuming. Also this poses a problem especially for female passengers who want to report something urgently or send an SOS but are force logged out and have to do the whole long procedure of logging in
